articles.title: Xbox Reveals Original and 360 Boot-Up Options for 25th Anniversary
articles.summary: Microsoft has revealed three new nostalgic Xbox console boot-up options for Xbox Series X/S and Xbox One as part of a new update for the brand's 25th anniversary. Xbox has been around a long time, and those who have stuck around for the full ride have seen it through plenty of ups and downs.
body: These three new animations are largely untouched rips of the same boot-up videos from some of the earliest days of Microsoft's gaming endeavors. The Original is the same sci-fi-inspired introduction that played for original Xbox consoles. The other two options are Xbox 360-themed, with one being based on the 2005 startup and the other based on the 2010 startup.

Xbox has been going hard on the nostalgia to help celebrate its 25th anniversary today. In addition to the three new boot-up animations, Microsoft published the Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine, which offered a full layout for the company's 25-year history in games and what's coming next.

Part of the future includes plotting ahead for Project Helix, a project the company has previously described as a family of devices that could mark a new path forward for Xbox. It all arrives as Microsoft navigates a tough year for the brand, which has seen it introduce a new CEO in Asha Sharma and announce thousands of layoffs.
points: Microsoft has revealed three new nostalgic Xbox console boot-up options for Xbox Series X/S and Xbox One as part of a new update for the brand's 25th anniversary.
The other two options are Xbox 360-themed, with one being based on the 2005 startup and the other based on the 2010 startup.

articles.title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Will Start as Small-Time Criminals Who Have to Work Up to High-Value Jobs
articles.summary: GTA 6 will let Jason and Lucia pull off high-value jobs, but Rockstar Games asks players to work up from being small-time criminals first. The latest peek at this week's new Grand Theft Auto game arrived courtesy of a preview piece from The Guardian (via @GameRoll_ ).
body: Jason and Lucia are two names we've heard for years, and they're not about to go away any time soon. After 13 years, faithful GTA fans will soon finally go hands-on with the next mainline game in the groundbreaking open-world sandbox series. They won't be able to immediately pull off front-page heists out of the gate, though.

The Guardian said players won't be allowed to have the duo rob Vice City jewelry stores or drive around Leonida in sports cars in the early moments of GTA 6. Instead, they'll only be able to "hotwire low-end vehicles and pick basic locks" until they work their way up to high-value work later. What the threshold to reach those moments is remains unclear, but considering Rockstar has toiled away on the game for more than a decade, it's probably best that players don't burn their way to the top too quickly.

articles.title: Tom Cruise's Favorite Director's Breakout Action Thriller Is Officially Free to Stream
articles.summary: As strange as it may be from a modern perspective, there was a point at which Christopher McQuarrie did not work with Tom Cruise. 20 years before McQuarrie directed four Mission: Impossible movies in a row, he got on moviegoers' radar by writing the Oscar-winning script for 1995's The Usual…
body: We don't talk quite as much about Usual Suspects as we used to, as much of it's built around a truly incredible performance by the since-disgraced Kevin Spacey, but it's one of the greatest movies in the neo-noir crime revival of the '90s. In theory, that and the Oscar should've given McQuarrie a blank check to do whatever he wanted. Instead, he was unemployed for the next five years.

Finally, McQuarrie wrote and directed his own follow-up to Usual Suspects just to put himself back on the film industry's radar. That was 2000's The Way of the Gun, which is an angry reaction to McQuarrie's years in Hollywood. It's an action movie that deliberately does everything that a film executive wouldn't want to see come across their desk, such as long silences, surprisingly subtle plot beats, and two of the most deliberately unsympathetic protagonists in American movie history. If you brought this to Kevin Zaslav, he’d spontaneously combust.

articles.title: Xbox Confirms Project Helix Is 'a Console Capable of Playing Games From Your PC'
articles.summary: Xbox has confirmed Project Helix is "designed to be a console capable of playing games from your PC."
body: Microsoft unveiled a slew of details about its past, present, and future with the surprise publication of the Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine. It's all part of surprise festivities meant to help celebrate 25 years of Xbox, and it also happens to have revealed more information about Project Helix than we've received in some time.

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has called the next-gen project a "family of devices" before, and although that language is used again here, vice president of next generation Jason Ronald helped paint a clearer picture. The main idea here is that, through the ups and downs of Xbox's history, many lessons have been learned.

"When we think about Project Helix, it's really designed to be the ultimate gaming machine – one that removes all the barriers of play that have historically existed," Ronald said. "My entire library is accessible to me. I'm able to bring four generations of my Xbox library and progression with me and have it available instantly. And we remove the arbitrary constraints between console and PC games."
points: Xbox has confirmed Project Helix is "designed to be a console capable of playing games from your PC."

articles.title: EA Adds 'Don't Delete' Message to Madden NFL 27 in Bid to Keep Players From Making Room Ahead of GTA 6
articles.summary: EA has added a "don't delete" pop-up message to Madden NFL 27, and players can't help but feel the company is begging them not to make room for Grand Theft Auto 6. Reports of the new in-game notice began cropping up over the weekend, with CharlieIntel relaying their findings online.
body: The message encourages Madden NFL 27 users to refrain from uninstalling the game from their devices, promising that those who stick around can look forward to a new update coming Tuesday, November 17. It's a bit beside the point, but we should also mention that, at least based on early screenshots, EA's message includes a typo, writing "awating signal" instead of "awaiting signal." Newer posts suggest it was fixed pretty quickly. Whoops!

"Don't Delete!" the Madden pop-up says. "[ENCRYPTED SIGNAL] The target is locked. The crew is assembling for a high-stakes run. Await the signal from our insider on 11/17… do not leak this transmission!"

There's just no getting around it; the next week is going to be very, very weird for the gaming industry. GTA 6, a decade-in-the-making video game said to bring the biggest launch of all time, has mostly seen every other game clear the calendar just to make room for it. The atmosphere surrounding Rockstar Games' latest is something to behold, and with millions of players still turning up for live-service titles, one can wonder if any of their developers are worried about GTA 6 taking a chunk of their attention.

articles.title: Prime Video's Near-Perfect Game of Thrones Replacement Officially Arrives in 2 Months
articles.summary: A weak king rules over a cobbled-together kingdom that's already coming apart at the seams. Various heroes and villains compete and scheme to claim the throne. A new challenger rises up from across the sea, full of vengeance and bloodlust...
body: Back in October, during New York Comic Con 2026, I attended an early screening of Bloodaxe, a new series from Vikings creator Michael Hirst and his son Horatio. Based on the show's first episode, which premieres Jan. 20, 2027 on Prime Video, the streamer might just have a new Game of Thrones -level hit on its hands. Or at the very least, an entertaining show for VIkings fans.

That might sound like a lot of plot to pack into one hour of television, and… it is. But Michael and Horatio Hirst deftly plunge us into this world headfirst like a Viking warrior sprinting into the frigid Norwegian Sea. Like Game of Thrones, Bloodaxe pulls out all the stops in its opening act to win over its audience. That means plenty of political intrigue, shocking deaths, stunning scenery, meticulous production design, beautiful actors, and gratuitous sex scenes.

articles.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s No. 1 cause of death officially revealed
articles.summary: The Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has officially been out for more than two weeks, and saying its reception has been good would be an understatement. It was named the No. 2 best-selling game on the Nintendo Switch 2, with over 5.2 million copies reportedly sold less than four days after launch.
body: Now that the Ocarina of Time remake has been out for a few weeks, global data stored in the Zelda Notes app is revealing certain details about the way people are playing the game, including the No. 1 cause of death for players. ReDeads are the most dangerous enemies, with 18% of players falling victim to the zombie-like monsters that can paralyze Link with fear.
Keep in mind that global data is subject to change as more people complete playthroughs of the Ocarina of Time remake, but it's interesting to see the early waves of data now available.

articles.title: Police arrest suspect after drive-by shooting at office campus housing Xbox studio inXile
articles.summary: Police have arrested a suspect after a drive-by shooting at an office campus in Tustin, California, which is home to Xbox-owned studio inXile Entertainment.
body: According to Aftermath, officers responded to reports of a drive-by shooting at Flight at Tustin Legacy, a campus that houses inXile and other businesses, on 11th November.

"Located multiple shell casings. Nobody was hurt," Tustin Police Sergeant Christopher Peterson told the outlet. "Processed the crime scene, and then sometime [Friday] morning, a little before 11 [AM], they took a suspect into custody. And the investigation is still kind of ongoing as to where and why."
"We're relieved that no one was hurt at our inXile office," an inXile spokesperson said. "Our focus is on supporting our team, and we are working closely with law enforcement as they investigate."
Police have not given a motive, and the suspect has not been named.

articles.title: 17 Years Ago, the Longest Running Sci-Fi Show Flipped Its Core Concept On Its Head
articles.summary: If there’s one thing you can’t say about Tennant, it’s that he lacks range. He can play a lover, a fighter, or the scummiest person you know. But his most iconic role as the time-traveling alien known as the Doctor in the sci-fi family show Doctor Who brings all three together.
body: David Tennant has long been recognized as one of the greatest actors alive. He’s played scoundrels, cops, serial killers, and even a demon — an actual one, not a member of the Conservative Party, though he’s played one of those too.

That might be a shocking statement to process. One of the Doctor’s core moral philosophies, articulated as early as Classic Who in 1963, is that the Time Lord is ultimately a peaceful person. During the Twelfth Doctor’s (Peter Capaldi) regeneration in 2017, one of his very last statements was that the future Doctor should “never be cruel, never be cowardly, and never ever eat pears! Remember, hate is always foolish, but love is always wise. Always try to be nice, but never fail to be kind.”
And yet, Tennant’s Tenth Doctor was the opposite of all those things during the 2009 autumnal Doctor Who special, "The Waters of Mars."
There have always been moments when the Doctor has shown that, for every person he has saved over the centuries, there have been just as many whom he has condemned.
points: If there’s one thing you can’t say about Tennant, it’s that he lacks range.
He can play a lover, a fighter, or the scummiest person you know.
But his most iconic role as the time-traveling alien known as the Doctor in the sci-fi family show Doctor Who brings all three together.
One of the Doctor’s core moral philosophies, articulated as early as Classic Who in 1963, is that the Time Lord is ultimately a peaceful person.

articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077 mod Torrent adds 3D rain, lightning storms, and tyre spray to Night City
articles.summary: A new Cyberpunk 2077 mod has overhauled Night City's rain, swapping the game's flat wet weather effects for individual 3D drops and adding lightning storms.
body: As spotted by DSOGaming, modder CyanideX's mod, Torrent, gives each raindrop its own size and falling speed. The drops also react to the player's movement, so they stream towards the windscreen when you're driving fast. If you find the wind has picked up, blustery weather can also push them sideways, too.

The rain also catches the light from street lamps, neon signs, car headlights, and taillights, and won't fall through roofs or inside buildings. Drops splash on the ground, heavy rain leaves mist in the distance, and cars throw up spray from their tyres on wet roads.
The mod complements this with a new lightning system, with branching bolts that flash and flicker before fading, and that can arrive in bursts during heavier storms.
If you like a little lightning, the frequency of bolts can be adjusted across 10 levels, and with the AudioXL mod installed, thunder follows each strike, timed to how far away it landed.

articles.title: Treyarch lays off lead Call of Duty writer and Zombies veteran after "approximately 20 years" of service
articles.summary: Treyarch's former Senior lead writer, Craig Houston, has been laid off after approximately 20 years of service with the developer. In a post made to both his Twitter/X account and LinkedIn, the developer thanked fans for their support during his two decades with the company and confirmed he was…
body: "After approximately 20 years, I was sadly one of those affected by recent layoffs," he noted in his posts. "I am proud to have worked with so many talented people - many of whom will remain friends for life. Thanks to all the fans for your enthusiasm, support, and kind words over the years."

On Twitter/X, he quote tweeted a video celebrating 30 years of Treyarch and featuring footage from many of the games he worked on to share his message. It appears the layoffs referenced are part of the broad reorganistation affecting 3200 jobs that Xbox announced earlier this year. Treyarch, as part of Activision Blizzard, is owned by Xbox.

Houston is a bonafide veteran of the esteemed FPS series. His first Call of Duty title at Treyarch was Call of Duty 3, where he worked as a video editor. This was followed by World at War, Black Ops 1 through 4, where he is credited as a writer and designer. For Modern Warfare, Black Ops - Cold War, Vanguard, Modern Warfare 3, then Black Ops 6 and 7, he is listed as a member of the design team and in 'creative development'. He is not credited on this year's Modern Warfare 4.

articles.title: Are you more of an ambient music enjoyer or theatrical atmosphere appreciator?
articles.summary: When World of Warcraft: Forever's beta first launched, I lamented its long stretches of silence and penchant for ambience over theatrics. I still sort of stand by that, but after spending more time in Azeroth (and discovering the loop music setting) I've a new-found appreciation for both WoW's…
body: It's also got me thinking about what makes a soundtrack ambient versus something more melodic. I'm chronically Final Fantasy 14-brained, where just about everything has a grand thematic soundtrack to it—the jauntiness of the Gold Saucer, the soothing Middle-earthness of Gridania's outer Shroud zones, the grand organs of Ishgard's bitterly cold landscape. You can't escape composer Masayoshi Soken's penchant for leifmotifs. He will turn anything into an orchestral spectacle.

I'm a big JRPG fan in general, a genre I think is the absolute master of thematic soundtracks. But I also think fondly of games I've played over the years that are a little more pared down, their soundtracks there for a little atmosphere rather than actively driving the narrative. Minecraft's OST is a masterclass in ambience, and is in regular rotation across my videogame-themed Spotify playlists. I also have a huge soft spot for the soundtrack behind Mirror's Edge—one which settles in this almost otherworldly ambiance, only ramping up when Faith is in a perilous situation.

articles.title: Blade Runner 2099 bosses hint at a possible "triple-A" Blade Runner game in the future - just don't expect it any time soon
articles.summary: Blade Runner 2099 - an upcoming TV miniseries coming to Amazon Prime Video, acting as a sequel to Blade Runner (1982) and Blade Runner 2049 (2017) - might be getting a video game. And a 'triple-A' video game, at that.
body: In a new interview with IGN, the duo reveal that they had thought about adapting the Blade Runner fracnhise into a game, and that - should it come to fruition - it would target "triple-A" in scope. Other than that, the duo seemed to want to keep any potential information to themselves. Given they appear to be in talks about the title, rather than in any active development, if something did come of this ideation, it would no doubt be a long, long way off. Kosove and Johnson's aim seems to be getting players to "interact" more with the world of Blade Runner, which has recently been fleshed out by the 2017 movie and is set to be developed more in the upcoming series.

Of course, we've seen Blade Runner games before. There was 1997's simply-titled Blade Runner - developed by Westwood Studios and published by Virgin Interactive - which was a point-and-click adventure that really seemed to pick up the vibes the original Ridley Scott was putting down. An Enhanced Edition of the game was released in 2022, which is actually more of a remake than a simple enhancement.

articles.title: League of Legends will get an overhaul called New Dawn with new visuals, build options, and an updated client
articles.summary: Riot has announced a League of Legends overhaul that promises to touch every aspect of the game. "We want League to stand the test of time and be a game that's here for many years to come," said League Studio head Andrei "Meddler" van Roon in a teaser trailer.
body: The headlining changes coming with the update, called New Dawn, are a "modernized" client, a graphical revamp for the 5v5 map Summoner's Rift (the last time this happened was in 2014 ), and "new ways to play" each champion.

While details are scarce in the teaser, some brief footage is shown where you can see what he's talking about: a Blitzcrank player selects what looks like a character-specific mastery tree labeled "God Hand," and it cuts to him beating up an enemy in melee. Other champions are shown using abilities in ways they currently can't—Vayne, for instance, dashes through a wall.

An updated art style is also shown off, including new character models for all sorts of champions as well as bosses like Baron Nashor and the Elder Dragon. It looks much more in line with the art style of Wild Rift, League of Legends' mobile port-slash-spinoff with high-detail character models.
Player reactions are, as you might expect with an update that promises to be so comprehensive, all over the map.

articles.title: The pandemic was transformative for Jackbox: 'We went from a gamer name to a household name'
articles.summary: It's no secret that the Covid-19 pandemic saw a lot of people using videogames to stave off lockdown blues, and the Jackbox Party Pack games were especially well-suited for the role: easy-to-understand party fare that's optionally family-friendly and easy to play over a video call.
body: In a recent interview with PC Gamer associate editor Ted Litchfield, Jackbox Games CEO Mike Bilder said that the pandemic proved transformative for the developer.

"The industry at large obviously saw a lot of success at that time, but we did as well, and we went from a gamer name to a household name," he said, noting it was an "unfortunate period of time for the world, but for the gaming industry, a good one, and for Jackbox, a good one as well."

"That was kind of a leveling up for Jackbox as a company," said Bilder. "Suddenly office workers are doing happy hours and families over weekends are connecting over a game of Whiplash or something because it's what you did when you were locked down. People realized how easy it was to just share the screen over a Zoom call and everyone's playing."
It surprised employees at the studio to see how popular the games had become.

The free-to-play strange wilderness has been warped into an acoustic nightmare driven by Joy, Anger, Sorrow, and Fear.

videos.title: Metro 2033/Last Light: PS5/Pro/Xbox Series X|S Upgrade Tested - Can All Consoles Run at 120Hz?
body: To stoke excitement for the impending Metro 2039, 4A Games revisits the first two games in the series with a 4K and 60FPS upgrade on PS5 and Xbox Series X. Texture quality is boosted, and ambient occlusion is improved - and there's even a 120Hz mode to further sweeten the deal (at a resolution hit). Tom runs through all the improvements compared to the last-gen release.
